verdict.rationale: An accounting SaaS could plausibly offer user automation rules with version history, review and rollback, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers vendor-side API resource versioning via the X-Version header and an API changelog, which concern API breaking changes rather than letting users version, review or roll back their own automations. The REST API and partner integrations are developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
